-- ============================================
-- 1. CUSTOMER TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Customers (
    customerID     VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    fullName       VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    phone          VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    customerType   VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'GUEST' NOT NULL,
    createdDate    DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uk_customer_email UNIQUE (email),
    CONSTRAINT chk_customer_type CHECK (customerType IN ('GUEST', 'MEMBER')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_customer_email CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(email, '@')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_customer_phone CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(phone, '-'))
);


-- ============================================
-- 2. MEMBER TABLE (Subtype of Customer)
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Members (
    customerID     VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    currentTier    VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Normal' NOT NULL,
    memberPoints   NUMBER(8) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    memberRegDate  DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    expiryDate     DATE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_member_customer FOREIGN KEY (customerID) REFERENCES Customers(customerID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_members_tier CHECK (currentTier IN ('Normal', 'VIP')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_members_points CHECK (memberPoints >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_members_expiry_date CHECK (
        (currentTier = 'Normal' AND expiryDate IS NULL) OR
        (currentTier = 'VIP' AND expiryDate > memberRegDate)
    )
);


-- ============================================
-- 3. MEMBERSHIP HISTORY
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Membership_History (
    historyID        VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    transactionDate  DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    memberTier       VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    currentStatus    VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    changeReason     VARCHAR2(255),
    customerID       VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_history_member FOREIGN KEY (customerID) REFERENCES Members(customerID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_history_tier CHECK (memberTier IN ('Normal', 'VIP')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_history_status CHECK (currentStatus IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED'))
);


-- ============================================
-- 4. VOUCHER TYPES
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Voucher_Type (
    voucherID       VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    discountValue   NUMBER(5,2) NOT NULL,
    requiredPoints  NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    voucherExpiry   NUMBER DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL, -- validity period in days
    CONSTRAINT chk_voucher_discount CHECK (discountValue > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_voucher_points CHECK (requiredPoints >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_voucher_expiry CHECK (voucherExpiry > 0)
);


-- ============================================
-- 5. PAYMENTS (Supports both Orders and VIP payments)
--    Moved up so Orders can reference it directly
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Payments (
    paymentID      VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    paymentMethod   VARCHAR2(30) NOT NULL,
    AmountPaid      NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    paymentStatus   VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'COMPLETED' NOT NULL,
    paymentDateTime DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    transaction_ref VARCHAR2(100) UNIQUE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_payment_amount CHECK (AmountPaid > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_payment_status CHECK (paymentStatus IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_payment_method CHECK (paymentMethod IN ('CREDIT_CARD', 'DEBIT_CARD', 'E_WALLET', 'ONLINE_BANKING', 'CASH', 'MYKASIH'))
);


-- ============================================
-- 6. BRANCH
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Branch (
    branchID      VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    branchName    VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL,
    branchAddress VARCHAR2(255) NOT NULL,
    BranchPhone   VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    BranchEmail   VARCHAR2(100),
    CONSTRAINT uk_branch_name UNIQUE (branchName),
    CONSTRAINT chk_branch_phone CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(BranchPhone, '-')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_branch_email CHECK (BranchEmail IS NULL OR REGEXP_LIKE(BranchEmail, '@'))
);


-- ============================================
-- 7. DELIVERY COMPANY
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Delivery_Company (
    companyID      VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    companyName    VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    companyPhone   VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    companyEmail   VARCHAR2(100),
    companyAddress VARCHAR2(255) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uk_del_company_name UNIQUE (companyName),
    CONSTRAINT chk_del_company_phone CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(companyPhone, '-')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_del_company_email CHECK (companyEmail IS NULL OR REGEXP_LIKE(companyEmail, '@'))
);


-- ============================================
-- 8. MEMBER VOUCHER
--    Created before Orders since Orders FKs to it
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Member_Voucher (
    member_voucherID VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    isRedeemed       CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'F' NOT NULL,
    customerID       VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    voucherID        VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_mv_redeemed CHECK (isRedeemed IN ('T','F')),
    CONSTRAINT fk_mv_member  FOREIGN KEY (customerID)  REFERENCES Members(customerID)ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_mv_voucher FOREIGN KEY (voucherID) REFERENCES Voucher_Type(voucherID)
);
-- ============================================
-- 9. ORDERS
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Orders (
    orderID            VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    orderStatus        VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    orderType          VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    totalAmount        NUMBER(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL,
    order_datetime     DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    completed_datetime DATE,
    customerID         VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    member_voucherID   VARCHAR2(10) ,
    branchID           VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    paymentID          VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_status CHECK (orderStatus IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_type CHECK (orderType IN ('DELIVERY', 'PICKUP')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_total CHECK (totalAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_order_completed CHECK (completed_datetime IS NULL OR completed_datetime >= order_datetime),
    CONSTRAINT fk_order_customer FOREIGN KEY (customerID) REFERENCES Customers(customerID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_order_voucher  FOREIGN KEY (member_voucherID) REFERENCES Member_Voucher(member_voucherID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_order_branch   FOREIGN KEY (branchID) REFERENCES Branch(branchID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_order_payment  FOREIGN KEY (paymentID) REFERENCES Payments(paymentID)
);
-- ============================================
-- 10. DELIVERY
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Delivery (
    deliveryID       VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    deliveryStatus   VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    deliveryFee      NUMBER(7,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL,
    trackingNo       VARCHAR2(50) UNIQUE,
    scheduledDate    DATE NOT NULL,
    deliverDate      DATE,
    deliveryAddress  VARCHAR2(255) NOT NULL,
    orderID          VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    companyID        VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_delivery_status CHECK (deliveryStatus IN ('PENDING', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_delivery_fee CHECK (deliveryFee >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_delivery_date CHECK (deliverDate IS NULL OR deliverDate >= scheduledDate),
    CONSTRAINT fk_delivery_order   FOREIGN KEY (orderID) REFERENCES Orders(orderID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_delivery_company FOREIGN KEY (companyID) REFERENCES Delivery_Company(companyID)
);


-- ============================================
-- 11. DELIVERY RATING
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE DeliveryRating (
    DelRatingID        VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    DelRatingScore     NUMBER(1) NOT NULL,
    DelComments        VARCHAR2(500),
    DelRatingTimestamp DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    deliveryID         VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_delrating_score CHECK (DelratingScore BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    CONSTRAINT fk_drating_delivery FOREIGN KEY (deliveryID) REFERENCES Delivery(deliveryID) ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================
-- 12. PICKUPS
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Pickups (
    pickupID   VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    trackingNo VARCHAR2(50) UNIQUE,
    pickupDate DATE NOT NULL,
    pickupTime VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    orderID    VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_pickup_order FOREIGN KEY (orderID) REFERENCES Orders(orderID)
);

-- ============================================
-- 13. ITEMS
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Items (
    itemID    VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    category  VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL,
    itemName  VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    price     NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uk_item_name UNIQUE (itemName),
    CONSTRAINT chk_item_price CHECK (price >= 0)
);


-- ============================================
-- 14. BRANCH STOCK
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Branch_Stock (
    branchID  VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    itemID    VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    stockQty  NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (branchID, itemID),
    CONSTRAINT chk_stock_qty CHECK (stockQty >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_stock_branch FOREIGN KEY (branchID) REFERENCES Branch(branchID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_stock_item   FOREIGN KEY (itemID)   REFERENCES Items(itemID) ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================
-- 15. ORDER DETAILS
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Order_Details (
    orderID     VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    itemID      VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    itemAmount  NUMBER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    unitPrice   NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (orderID, itemID),
    CONSTRAINT chk_od_amount CHECK (itemAmount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_od_price  CHECK (unitPrice >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_od_order FOREIGN KEY (orderID) REFERENCES Orders(orderID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_od_item  FOREIGN KEY (itemID)  REFERENCES Items(itemID)
);


-- ============================================
-- 16. ITEM RATING (Enforces one rating per order item)
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE ItemRating (
    ratingID        VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    ratingScore     NUMBER(1) NOT NULL,
    comments        VARCHAR2(500),
    ratingTimestamp DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    orderID         VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    itemID          VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_ir_score CHECK (ratingScore BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    CONSTRAINT uk_itemrating UNIQUE (orderID, itemID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_ir_orderitem FOREIGN KEY (orderID, itemID) REFERENCES Order_Details(orderID, itemID) ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================
-- 17. PROMOTIONS
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Promotions (
    promoID         VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    promo_name       VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    promo_type       VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    discount_percent NUMBER(5,2) NOT NULL,
    start_date       DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date         DATE NOT NULL,
    isActive         CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'T' NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_active CHECK (isActive IN ('T','F')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_dates CHECK (start_date <= end_date),
    CONSTRAINT chk_promo_discount CHECK (discount_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
);


-- ============================================
-- 18. PROMOTION ITEM (Many-to-Many)
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Promotion_Item (
    promoID   VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    itemID    VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (promoID, itemID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_pi_promo FOREIGN KEY (promoID) REFERENCES Promotions(promoID)ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_pi_item  FOREIGN KEY (itemID)   REFERENCES Items(itemID)ON DELETE CASCADE
);


-- ============================================
-- 19. REFUND
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Refund (
    refundID          VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    refundDate        DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    refundStatus      VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    refundMethod      VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    totalRefundAmount NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    orderID           VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_refund_status CHECK (refundStatus IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'PROCESSED')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_refund_amount CHECK (totalRefundAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_refund_order FOREIGN KEY (orderID) REFERENCES Orders(orderID)
);


-- ============================================
-- 20. REFUND ITEM
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE Refund_Item (
    refund_itemID    VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    refundQty        NUMBER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    refundReason     VARCHAR2(30) NOT NULL,
    unitRefundAmount NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    refundID         VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    itemID           VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    orderID          VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_ri_qty CHECK (refundQty > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_ri_amount CHECK (unitRefundAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_ri_refund    FOREIGN KEY (refundID) REFERENCES Refund(refundID)ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_ri_orderitem FOREIGN KEY (orderID, itemID) REFERENCES Order_Details(orderID, itemID)
);


-- ============================================
-- 21. MYKASIH ACCOUNT
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE MyKasih_Account (
    myKasihID        VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    ic_number        VARCHAR2(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    holderName       VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    monthlyLimit     NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    remainingBalance NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    accountStatus    VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
    registeredDate   DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    customerID       VARCHAR2(10) UNIQUE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_mkasih_status CHECK (accountStatus IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'INACTIVE')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_mkasih_limit CHECK (monthlyLimit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_mkasih_balance CHECK (remainingBalance >= 0 AND remainingBalance <= monthlyLimit),
    CONSTRAINT fk_mkasih_customer FOREIGN KEY (customerID) REFERENCES Customers(customerID)
);


-- ============================================
-- 22. MYKASIH TRANSACTION
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE MyKasih_Transaction (
    myKasihTxnID  VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    myKasihID     VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    orderID       VARCHAR2(10) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    amountUsed    NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    txnDate       DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_mktxn_amount CHECK (amountUsed > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_mktxn_account FOREIGN KEY (myKasihID) REFERENCES MyKasih_Account(myKasihID),
    CONSTRAINT fk_mktxn_order   FOREIGN KEY (orderID) REFERENCES Orders(orderID)
);


-- ============================================
-- 23. VIP RENEWAL
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE VIP_Renewal (
    customerID      VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    renewalFee      NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL,
    nextRenewalDate DATE NOT NULL,
    paymentID       VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chk_vip_fee CHECK (renewalFee > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_vip_member  FOREIGN KEY (customerID) REFERENCES Members(customerID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_vip_payment FOREIGN KEY (paymentID) REFERENCES Payments(paymentID)
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfCustomers
FROM Customers;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfMembers
FROM Members;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfMembershipHistory
FROM Membership_History;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfVoucherType
FROM Voucher_Type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfPayments
FROM Payments;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfBranch
FROM Branch;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfDeliveryCompany
FROM Delivery_Company;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfMemberVoucher
FROM Member_Voucher;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfOrders
FROM Orders;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfDelivery
FROM Delivery;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfDeliveryRating
FROM DeliveryRating;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfPickups
FROM Pickups;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfItems
FROM Items;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfBranchStock
FROM Branch_Stock;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfOrderDetails
FROM Order_Details;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfItemRating
FROM ItemRating;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfPromotions
FROM Promotions;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfPromotionItem
FROM Promotion_Item;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfRefund
FROM Refund;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfRefundItem
FROM Refund_Item;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfMyKasihAccount
FROM MyKasih_Account;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfMyKasihTransaction
FROM MyKasih_Transaction;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NoOfVIPRenewal
FROM VIP_Renewal;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_next_refund_id RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
BEGIN
    RETURN 'RF' || LPAD(seq_refund_id.NEXTVAL, 5, '0');
END fn_next_refund_id;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_categorize_reason (
    p_reason IN Refund_Item.refundReason%TYPE
) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
BEGIN
    RETURN CASE
        WHEN LOWER(p_reason) IN ('item damaged','item expired','poor quality')
        	THEN 'PRODUCT QUALITY'
        WHEN LOWER(p_reason) IN ('missing item','wrong item received','not as described','out of stock','store error')
        	THEN 'FULFILLMENT ERROR'
        WHEN LOWER(p_reason) IN ('late delivery','payment issue')
        	THEN 'LOGISTICS/PAYMENT'
        ELSE 'CUSTOMER PREFERENCE'
    END;
END fn_categorize_reason;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_s2_calc_completion_pct (
    p_stocked_items IN NUMBER,
    p_total_items   IN NUMBER
) RETURN NUMBER IS
BEGIN
    IF p_total_items = 0 THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    RETURN ROUND(p_stocked_items * 100 / p_total_items, 1);
END fn_s2_calc_completion_pct;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_branch_orders AS
SELECT
    b.branchID,
    b.branchName,
    COUNT(o.orderID)   AS total_orders,
    SUM(o.totalAmount) AS total_revenue
FROM Branch b
JOIN Orders o ON o.branchID = b.branchID
WHERE o.orderStatus = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY b.branchID, b.branchName;
/
 
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_branch_refunds AS
SELECT
    o.branchID,
    COUNT(r.refundID)    	AS total_refunds,
    SUM(r.totalRefundAmount) AS total_refund_amount
FROM Refund r
JOIN Orders o ON o.orderID = r.orderID
GROUP BY o.branchID;
/
 
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_branch_pending AS
SELECT
    o.branchID,
    COUNT(r.refundID)                  AS pending_count,
    TRUNC(MAX(SYSDATE - r.refundDate)) AS oldest_days_pending
FROM Refund r
JOIN Orders o ON o.orderID = r.orderID
WHERE r.refundStatus = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY o.branchID;
/
 
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_branch_processed AS
SELECT
    o.branchID,
    COUNT(r.refundID) AS processed_count,
    SUM(r.totalRefundAmount) AS processed_amount,
    TRUNC(MAX(SYSDATE - r.refundDate)) AS oldest_days_processed
FROM Refund r
JOIN Orders o ON o.orderID = r.orderID
WHERE r.refundStatus = 'PROCESSED'
GROUP BY o.branchID;
/
 
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_branch_completed AS
SELECT
    o.branchID,
    COUNT(r.refundID) AS completed_count,
    SUM(r.totalRefundAmount) AS completed_amount
FROM Refund r
JOIN Orders o ON o.orderID = r.orderID
WHERE r.refundStatus = ' APPROVED'
GROUP BY o.branchID;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_s2_item_search AS
SELECT i.itemID, i.itemName, i.category, i.price,
       NVL(SUM(bs.stockQty), 0) AS total_stock_all_branches,
       (SELECT ROUND(i.price * (1 - MAX(p.discount_percent) / 100), 2)
          FROM Promotion_Item pi JOIN Promotions p ON p.promoID = pi.promoID
         WHERE pi.itemID = i.itemID AND p.isActive = 'T' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date)
                                                          AS promo_price
  FROM Items i
  LEFT JOIN Branch_Stock bs ON bs.itemID = i.itemID
 GROUP BY i.itemID, i.itemName, i.category, i.price;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_s2_branch_catalog_value AS
SELECT b.branchID, b.branchName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.category) AS categories_carried,
       COUNT(bs.itemID)           AS distinct_items_stocked,
       SUM(bs.stockQty * i.price) AS stock_value
  FROM Branch b
  JOIN Branch_Stock bs ON bs.branchID = b.branchID
  JOIN Items i ON i.itemID = bs.itemID
 GROUP BY b.branchID, b.branchName;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_s2_branch_item_sales AS
SELECT o.branchID, od.itemID,
       SUM(od.itemAmount)         AS qty_sold,
       COUNT(DISTINCT od.orderID) AS order_count
  FROM Orders        o
  JOIN Order_Details  od ON od.orderID = o.orderID
 WHERE o.orderStatus != 'CANCELLED'
 GROUP BY o.branchID, od.itemID;


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_s2_promo_order_activity AS
SELECT o.orderID, o.branchID, o.order_datetime, od.itemID, od.itemAmount,
       pi.promoID, p.start_date, p.end_date,
       (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1) AS promo_days
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Order_Details      od ON od.orderID = o.orderID
  LEFT JOIN Promotion_Item pi ON pi.itemID = od.itemID
  LEFT JOIN Promotions      p ON p.promoID = pi.promoID
 WHERE o.orderStatus != 'CANCELLED';


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_s2_branch_item_rating AS
SELECT o.branchID, od.itemID,
       AVG(ir.ratingScore)  AS avg_rating,
       COUNT(ir.ratingID)   AS rating_count
  FROM Orders        o
  JOIN Order_Details  od ON od.orderID = o.orderID
  JOIN ItemRating     ir ON ir.orderID = od.orderID AND ir.itemID = od.itemID
 WHERE o.orderStatus != 'CANCELLED'
 GROUP BY o.branchID, od.itemID;


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_member_activity AS
SELECT
    m.customerID,
    NVL(order_stats.completed_orders, 0) AS completed_orders,
    NVL(order_stats.total_spending, 0) AS total_spending,
    NVL(order_stats.avg_order_value, 0) AS avg_order_value,
    NVL(voucher_stats.total_vouchers, 0) AS total_vouchers,
    NVL(voucher_stats.redeemed_vouchers, 0) AS redeemed_vouchers
FROM Members m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        customerID,
        COUNT(orderID) AS completed_orders,
        SUM(totalAmount) AS total_spending,
        AVG(totalAmount) AS avg_order_value
    FROM Orders
    WHERE orderStatus = 'COMPLETED'
    GROUP BY customerID
) order_stats ON order_stats.customerID = m.customerID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        customerID,
        COUNT(member_voucherID) AS total_vouchers,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN isRedeemed = 'T' THEN member_voucherID END) AS redeemed_vouchers
    FROM Member_Voucher
    GROUP BY customerID
) voucher_stats ON voucher_stats.customerID = m.customerID;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_delivery_perf AS
SELECT
    d.companyID,
    COUNT(d.deliveryID) AS total_deliveries,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.deliveryStatus = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.deliveryStatus = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count,
    AVG(d.deliveryFee) AS avg_delivery_fee,
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN d.deliveryStatus = 'DELIVERED' AND d.deliverDate IS NOT NULL
             THEN d.deliverDate - d.scheduledDate END
    ) AS avg_delivery_days,
    rating_stats.avg_rating
FROM Delivery d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        del.companyID,
        AVG(dr.DelRatingScore) AS avg_rating
    FROM DeliveryRating dr
    JOIN Delivery del ON del.deliveryID = dr.deliveryID
    GROUP BY del.companyID
) rating_stats ON rating_stats.companyID = d.companyID
GROUP BY d.companyID, rating_stats.avg_rating;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cyz_customer_order_stats AS
SELECT
    c.customerID,
    c.fullName,
    c.customerType,
    NVL(m.currentTier, 'N/A') AS memberTier,
    COUNT(o.orderID) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.orderStatus = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.orderStatus = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.orderStatus = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_orders,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.orderStatus = 'COMPLETED'
               THEN o.completed_datetime - o.order_datetime END), 2) AS avg_days_to_complete,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.member_voucherID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS voucher_orders
FROM Customers c
LEFT JOIN Members m ON m.customerID = c.customerID
LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customerID = c.customerID
GROUP BY c.customerID, c.fullName, c.customerType, m.currentTier;
/
 
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cyz_order_payment_detail AS
SELECT
    o.orderID, o.orderStatus, o.orderType, o.totalAmount,
    o.order_datetime, o.completed_datetime,
    (o.completed_datetime - o.order_datetime) AS days_to_complete,
    o.customerID,
    c.customerType,
    NVL(m.currentTier, 'N/A') AS memberTier,
    p.paymentMethod, p.paymentStatus,
    CASE WHEN o.member_voucherID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS used_voucher
FROM Orders o
JOIN Customers c ON c.customerID = o.customerID
LEFT JOIN Members m ON m.customerID = o.customerID
JOIN Payments p ON p.paymentID = o.paymentID;
/

CREATE INDEX idx_items_category   ON Items(category);

CREATE INDEX idx_delivery_company ON Delivery (companyID);

CREATE INDEX idx_itemrating_item_score ON ItemRating (itemID, ratingScore);

CREATE INDEX idx_items_category_upper ON Items (UPPER(category));
CREATE INDEX idx_itemrating_item_time ON ItemRating (itemID, ratingTimestamp DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_refunditem_refundid ON Refund_Item (refundID);

CREATE INDEX idx_cyz_orders_status ON Orders(orderStatus);
